reviewMethod: independent existing agent; read-only document and corroborating source inspection
initialVerdict: Three P2 clarifications required before human review

findings.issue: Revocation beyond capped audit rows must not leave active result
findings.resolution: Exhaustive batched per-ID revocation EXISTS independent of audit cap; incomplete enrollment means unknown/untrusted, not active

findings.issue: Validated-ID filtering could hide malformed keys and imply absence
findings.resolution: Pre-filter invalid-key EXISTS over exact prefixes; complete=false/INVALID_RECORD/no absent or negative conclusion

findings.issue: Binding status lacked deterministic field/source predicates
findings.resolution: Exact canonical config precedence and task identity fields; missing/malformed/case/legacy type predicates; administrative only

finalVerdict: v1.1 is design-ready to present to the human owner. No remaining design blockers found.
limitations: No executable surface implemented, tests or workloads exercised by reviewer
No enrollment, exclusivity, provider identity, UAT or publication approval
Read-only view is not atomic with registration and does not enforce channel-exclusive trust
No blanket global-jobs or complete nonce/release-history absence prerequisite

verificationThisTurn.sourceInspection: existing native registration/pairing/release/lease/nonce CAS and revocation boundaries checked
verificationThisTurn.runtimeInspection: existing Tower container running/healthy only; no provider page opened
verificationThisTurn.newCodeTests: NOT RUN: design-only, final scenarios/implementation await human verdict
